nodes.title: Image / Keyframe Conditioning
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Edit the supplied wildlife source video in place. Preserve the original camera trajectory, cloudy coastal lighting, sand, water, distant shoreline, depth of field, motion timing, and every pixel outside the white mask. Inside the masked lower-central beach region only, replace the moving soldier crabs with small polished red metal crab sculptures that occupy the corresponding positions and follow the original animals' grounded lateral motion. Maintain correct perspective, contact shadows, sand interaction, occlusion, scale, and motion blur at the mask boundary. Do not alter the duration, frame rate, camera, background, or unmasked crabs.

overall_soundscape:
Preserve the source audio exactly, including coastal wind, distant surf, water movement, and all location ambience. Generate no replacement sound.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

widgets_values:
NIGHTLY • 0.6 BASELINE • Masked Video Inpaint

1. Install models and extra packs listed in example_workflows/README.md.
2. Copy the supplied assets to ComfyUI/input; select source media where requested.
3. Set a unique project run name, then edit scenes and the Generation Profile.
4. Follow the numbered columns left → right and inspect the saved results.

Recovery is disabled by default. Enable it only to assemble saved clips without sampling.
